verdict.rationale: Airbyte publishes a documented public API for programmatic control (create/manage connections, syncs) with dedicated authentication docs, plus complementary SDKs (PyAirbyte), Terraform provider, and explicit guidance on using it with orchestrators like Airflow — clearly enabling AI-native/agentic control of the platform. missing for 10: no independently discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec at the probed standard endpoints and no hands-on third-party confirmation of API robustness.
